hooks.name: Auto Deploy login.html → GitHub + Vercel
hooks.description: On every save of login.html: copies to index.html, commits + pushes to GitHub, deploys to Vercel production.

action.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "
  $file = 'd:\Dharya\login.html'
  $index = 'd:\Dharya\index.html'
  Copy-Item $file $index -Force
  git -C 'd:\Dharya' add login.html index.html
  $diff = git -C 'd:\Dharya' diff --cached --stat
  if ($diff) {
    $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
    git -C 'd:\Dharya' commit -m \"Auto-update login page [$ts]\"
    git -C 'd:\Dharya' push origin master 2>&1
    vercel --prod --yes --cwd 'd:\Dharya' 2>&1
    Write-Host 'Deployed to GitHub + Vercel'
  } else {
    Write-Host 'No changes to deploy'
  }
"
